obligations: Every non-rejected analysis is accounted for; incomplete viable analyses block accepting any subset.
Every accepted interpretation is the same inquiry clause/analysis, with licensed_syntax, references_complete, QUESTION force and exactly one claim.
Every qualified claim field and variable domain is retained. All positive and negative source matches are independently enumerated.
Each subresult is checked against all matches; omissions and duplicate receipts are rejected even if the headline status is unchanged.
Consensus compares kinds, statuses, binding values/statuses, and every (bindings, claim_id) pair separately by sign.
Top receipts retain the receipts of every interpretation. Disagreement yields DEFER and no top-level proofs or bindings.
Typed agreement witnesses come from the accepted claim itself. Same-lemma predicates in relative-clause interiors cannot provide the outer predicate witness.
WH UNKNOWN may retain negative counterproofs with no positively supported binding. Polar UNKNOWN must have neither sign.
New-schema records cannot bypass the inventory by dropping question_interpretations; historical single-query reports retain their legacy path.
Both evaluator code snapshots include the independent helper and its adversarial tests.

independent_peer_review.scope: Read-only review of the complete helper, after the authored tests were written.
independent_peer_review.finding: No concrete counterexample found under the stated separately validated document/inquiry premise. This is not a proof of all-input correctness.

limits: The helper does not establish parser completeness or Arabic reference adequacy. It relies on separate source/inquiry report validation and replay.
Passing authored protocol tests and two stored examples does not establish unrestricted Arabic understanding.
The construction scoring adapter recognizes complete interpretation inventories instead of demanding a unique top query; original gold expectations and counts are unchanged.
The original frozen independent holdout evaluator and inputs remain unchanged. Its H18 false alarm is reviewed separately after execution.
